players.product: mature-node logic / DRAM foundry; 3D AI Foundry silicon interposers, wafer-on-wafer (WoW) DRAM stacking; HBM post-wafer-fab (PWF) foundry services

quarterly_data.signal: PSMC company presentation (June 2026): 2025 revenue NT$47bn, growth rate YoY 4.5%; 2025 shipment 1.63 million wafers (300mm equivalent); 5 foundries (2x 8-inch / 3x 12-inch) across memory, logic, open foundry and 3D AI; 8,200+ employees as of Mar 31, 2026. 1Q26 (unreviewed): operating revenues NT$13,572 million (+9% QoQ, +22% YoY), net income NT$14,231 million, EPS NT$3.36; foundry wafer shipments 415 thousand 12-inch wafer equivalent (flat QoQ, +12% YoY).
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue NT$47bn (+4.5%); 1Q26 revenue NT$13,572 million (+22% YoY); EPS NT$3.36

quarterly_data.signal: PSMC fab capacity (deck, wafers per month in each wafer size): Fab 8A (8-inch, 350-110nm, logic / discrete) 75K WPM; Fab P1 + P2 (12-inch, 180-24nm, logic / memory / advanced packaging) 67K WPM; Fab P3 (12-inch, 30-1Xnm, memory) 35K WPM; Fab 8B (8-inch, 350-110nm, discrete) 36K WPM. Foundry utilization 88% in 1Q26 vs 82% in 4Q25 and 73% in 1Q25.
quarterly_data.figure: utilization 88% (1Q26); Fab 8A 75K, P1 + P2 67K, P3 35K, 8B 36K WPM

quarterly_data.signal: PSMC revenue mix as of 2026 Q1 revenue: Logic 52.8%, Memory 44% (consumer DRAM, niche DRAM, SLC NAND, NOR flash), 3D AI 3.2% (interposer / bridge, WoW DRAM, 4/8L DRAM + logic, HBM PWF, Si capacitor), the 3D AI business serving AI server / data center.

PSMC 3D AI foundry offering (deck): wafer-on-wafer (WoW) DRAM / logic stacking with 4x up to 8x DRAM layers (feasible spec / performance: density 2-8GB, bandwidth 1-8TB/s, >10k connections, movement energy <1pJ/bit); Si interposer / bridge up to 3.x X reticle size with up to 8 thick Cu layers; Si capacitor / IPD with embedded capacitance > 1000 nF/mm2; and HBM post wafer finishing (PWF).
quarterly_data.figure: WoW up to 8 DRAM layers, 1-8TB/s (feasible spec); interposer up to 3.x X reticle size

quarterly_data.signal: PSMC growth strategy (deck): further diversify the customer base with Japan, US and Europe customers; existing 8-inch and 12-inch fabs to serve more auto and industrial customers; the new 12-inch fab to run consumable products first and gradually AI, auto and industrial products; update DRAM technology to 1Xnm and above, filling gaps with complementary NOR and 2D NAND technology.

connects_to.relationship: long-term HBM post-wafer-fab (PWF) foundry-services partnership (alongside the Tongluo P5 fab sale)

contracts.signal: PSMC deck: in 2026 Fab P5 was sold to Micron Technology and PSMC is starting HBM post wafer finishing (PWF) foundry service for Micron, expanding its 3D AI business; PSMC joins the HBM ecosystem through technical collaboration with Micron.
